title: Bounded-constructible lower-shriek composition used by the condensed compositor
statement: For a prime $\ell$ and separated finite-type morphisms $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to S$ over a field of characteristic different from $\ell$, the canonical bounded-constructible $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ lower-shriek composition isomorphism $R(f\circ g)_!\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_!\circ Rg_!$, defined by the chosen compactification, common proper/open refinement, open and proper compositor, and proper/open exchange maps. This is the library composition boundedConstructibleLowerShriekComp_padicAlgCl of ShriekComposition, named for the transported condensed compositor.
